quote_1: Set a ⟦T1⟧ of three on the new codebase-navigation benchmark, figuring it'd force the agent to actually hold file contents in working memory instead of treating disk as free scratch space.
quote_2: Every item received a ⟦T2⟧ before model results were inspected. The ⟦T2⟧ was revised for 4.7% of items after annotators discovered hidden dependencies on unavailable credentials.
justification: ⟦T1⟧ is an enforced cap on repeated file access during runs, while ⟦T2⟧ is a preassigned, annotator-reviewed item classification affected by task dependencies. They are distinct evaluation mechanisms rather than variants of one another.
